jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As our Forward Deployed Engineer, you split your time 50/50 between engineering and customer interaction. No role will teach you more about becoming a great founder, listener & builder. One day you're integrating a legacy ERP, the next you're on a flight to a shop floor in Mexico, and in between you ship the fix. You'll navigate stakeholders from IT to the C-level, all at once, and nothing really prepares you for it.

  • Lead full-stack rollouts – own implementations end-to-end, from scoping and onboarding to integration and training, and align IT teams, engineers and C-level execs across Germany, the EU and the US

  • Design the product backbone – work hands-on with users, translate their pain into product improvements, and prototype features yourself, ideally writing production code when needed

  • Turn operations into product – every deployment becomes a blueprint for scale: you turn what you learned into reusable product features, data models and playbooks, and grow into roles like CPO or COO

This is a high-ownership, zero-handholding role, and only for someone who loves turning complexity into clarity and ships working solutions under pressure.

​

YOU

  • Fast-paced experience – 2+ years in a top-tier role (e.g., consulting), as a founder, or as an early employee in a high-growth startup, with a technical degree or background

  • Engineer first – you write production code, understand systems end-to-end, and when something breaks at a customer, you find the root cause

  • Industrial background – experience in manufacturing, industrial software, procurement, supply chain or another industrial domain is a plus

  • Product-minded – you listen to rants about ERP, nod wisely, and somehow turn them into product features that feel like magic

  • Quality-obsessed – you hold yourself to a high bar, dive deep into problems, and care about getting it right, not just getting it done

  • Ultra-professional & detail-obsessed – you earn trust with structure, polish, and docs so clean even a CTO stops asking questions

  • Crisis communicator – when things get hard, people look to you; you calm an impatient exec, win over a skeptical IT leader, and still crack a joke in the middle of it

  • Down-to-earth & relatable – you bond with shop-floor operators as easily as with boardroom execs, and you'll put on the safety shoes without being asked

  • Language – you speak native-level German and fluent English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich, with 10 to 30% travel

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

This is the most entrepreneurial and founder-like role we have at Dryft. As a Deployment Lead, you'll face questions you've never heard before, processes you've never seen, and customers who expected answers yesterday. One day you're with C-level executives, the next with shop-floor users trying AI for the first time, and in between you're building prototypes. Your goal is to find the solution that creates the most value, get it running, and make Dryft indispensable.

  • Lead deployments end-to-end – carry our customers from the first executive workshop to production use across their plants, with C-level execs, operators and IT

  • Shape the product – work daily with users, turn messy workflows into features, and collaborate closely with engineering to push the roadmap forward

  • Build for scale – turn deployments into repeatable playbooks and product features, build and lead the deployment team, and grow into roles like CPO or COO

This isn't a role where you sit back and follow a process. You'll be in the trenches, under pressure, solving problems most people wouldn't touch. You sit at the intersection of product, commercial and project management, and what you bring back shapes where Dryft goes next.

​

YOU

  • Fast-paced experience – 5+ years in a top-tier role (e.g., consulting), as a founder, or as an early employee in a high-growth startup

  • Technically curious – you're not afraid of technical depth and can explain complex topics simply; ideally you have a technical background

  • Industrial background – experience in manufacturing, industrial software, procurement, supply chain or another industrial domain is a plus

  • Founder DNA – you have high agency, drive and a serious work ethic; you thrive in ambiguity and anticipate next priorities instead of waiting for direction

  • Builder mindset – you solve problems; you listen deeply, ask sharp questions, and translate messy realities into scalable systems and products that actually work

  • Confident communicator – you can calm an impatient exec, win over a skeptical IT leader, and still crack a joke in the middle of it

  • Down-to-earth & relatable – you bond with shop-floor operators as easily as with boardroom execs, and you'll put on the safety shoes without being asked

  • Language – you speak native-level German and fluent English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich, with around 30% travel

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

  • Build agents people trust – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

  • Own features end-to-end – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, all the way to production

  • Work close to the users – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll build the core of the product, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.

​

YOU

  • Full-stack shipper – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

  • Highly technical – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

  • Product sense – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

  • You care about getting it right – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am

  • Sense of urgency – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in San Francisco (we support visa)

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

​

  • Build the content engine – write, design, shoot and edit it yourself, from launch posts to customer stories, trailers, photos and content sessions with the whole team

  • Set the creative direction – you define how Dryft looks and sounds everywhere, from the website and the smallest design detail to new launches, trade shows and hackathons

​

  • Cinematic eye – you film, light and edit in a cinematic style that makes a hydraulic press look like a movie

  • Designer, too – you design as well as you film and write, and you spot a misaligned logo on a trade show banner from across the hall

  • Always hunting for inspiration – you spot new formats on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube before they take off, and you use what works before anyone else does

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in San Francisco (we support visa)

​

THE ROLE

The best startups are built by exceptional people. As our Technical Community Lead, you'll spend your time meeting the most extraordinary builders, students, operators, founders and investors, often before they are actively considering their next move.

  • Host the room everyone wants to be in – run the hackathons, events and parties the best builders fly in for, where they meet each other, and meet Dryft

  • Connected everywhere it counts – from lecture halls to VC offices to late-night founder dinners, grow a network around Dryft that opens every door

  • Raise the bar with every hire – turn those relationships into exceptional hires; every person you bring into Dryft should raise the bar for the entire company

Building the world's best team is Dryft's highest priority, and this role gives you a front-row seat to what it takes to build a generational company.

​

YOU

  • Community builder – you bring together exceptional builders, founders and researchers, and nobody leaves when it's over

  • Talent radar – you know "who is going to make it" before anyone else; you might even run a secret spreadsheet of them at home

  • Magnetic energy – people feel it the moment you walk in; exceptional people are drawn to you, and leave inspired and excited about an ambitious mission

  • Founder mindset – you move with urgency, take full ownership, and build networks and systems from the ground up

  • Engineer at heart – you understand what engineers and operators are building, and they can tell from the first conversation

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in San Francisco (we support visa)

You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

Dryft is growing fast, and as our GTM Lead, you'll accelerate everything that comes next. One day you're in a boardroom winning over a room full of skeptics, the next you're on a plane to a partner's plant to turn their pilot into a multi-year partnership, and the week after you're at one of the biggest trade shows in the world.

  • Open new partnerships – find the manufacturers who need Dryft the most, and own every step from the first touchpoint to the C-level conversation to the signed pilot

  • Grow every partnership – become the person our partners call first, expand from one plant to every plant they run, and shape what Dryft builds next

  • Build a scalable GTM engine – turn what works into the playbook for every next partner, lay the foundation for the future team, and grow into roles like Head of GTM or Head of Europe/US

There's no blueprint yet. You'll build it with our founders, and you'll be the reason we scale even faster.

​

YOU

  • Fast-paced experience – 2+ years in a top-tier client-facing role (e.g., consulting), as a founder, or as an early employee in a high-growth startup

  • Fascinated by industry – you're excited to learn how manufacturing really works

  • Executive presence – you read a boardroom in ten seconds, and leave an impression they still talk about weeks later

  • Sharp mind – you pick up a new industry over a weekend, and remember the detail everyone else forgot three meetings ago

  • Competitive by nature – you have a track record of winning at something hard, and you're not done winning

  • Ultra-professional & detail-obsessed – you earn trust with structure, polish, and docs so clean even a CFO would shed a tear

  • Language – you speak native-level German and fluent English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich, with 30 to 50% travel

 - Build a scalable GTM engine – turn what works into the playbook for every next partner, lay the foundation for the future team, and grow into roles like Head of GTM or Head of Europe/US

There's no blueprint yet. You'll build it with our founders, and you'll be the reason we scale even faster.




YOU

 - Fast-paced experience – 2+ years in a top-tier client-facing role (e.g., consulting), as a founder, or as an early employee in a high-growth startup

 - Fascinated by industry – you're excited to learn how manufacturing really works

 - Executive presence – you read a boardroom in ten seconds, and leave an impression they still talk about weeks later

 - Sharp mind – you pick up a new industry over a weekend, and remember the detail everyone else forgot three meetings ago

 - Competitive by nature – you have a track record of winning at something hard, and you're not done winning

 - Ultra-professional & detail-obsessed – you earn trust with structure, polish, and docs so clean even a CFO would shed a tear

 - Language – you speak native-level German and fluent English

 - Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich, with 30 to 50% travel

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As our Founders Associate Intern, you'll step into the shoes of a founder. You'll own the highest-priority projects across product, sales, hiring or operations. One day you're on site with a client, the next you're building a new prototype, and in between you're hosting a hackathon for the best builders in the city.

  • Founder DNA – you have high agency, drive and a serious work ethic; you thrive in ambiguity and anticipate next priorities instead of waiting for direction

  • Learning at full speed – you're useful in week one and indispensable by week four

  • Competitive by nature – you've won at something hard, and you're not done winning

  • Gets shit done & zero ego – you move fast, figure things out, and you'd rather ship it than get the credit

  • Language – you speak native-level German and fluent English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in San Francisco (we support visa)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

This is the most entrepreneurial and founder-like role we have at Dryft. As a Deployment Strategist, you'll face questions you've never heard before, processes you've never seen, and customers who expected answers yesterday. One day you're with C-level executives, the next with shop-floor users trying AI for the first time, and in between you're building prototypes. Your goal is to find the solution that creates the most value, get it running, and make Dryft indispensable.

  • Own deployments end-to-end – carry our customers from the first executive workshop to production use across their plants, with C-level execs, operators and IT

  • Shape the product – work daily with users, turn messy workflows into features, and collaborate closely with engineering to push the roadmap forward

  • Build for scale – turn deployments into repeatable playbooks and product features, lay the foundation for the future team, and grow into roles like Deployment Lead or Head of Europe/US

This isn't a role where you sit back and follow a process. You'll be in the trenches, under pressure, solving problems most people wouldn't touch. You sit at the intersection of product, commercial and project management, and what you bring back shapes where Dryft goes next.

​

YOU

  • Fast-paced experience – you've worked in a top-tier role (e.g., consulting), as a founder, or as an early employee in a high-growth startup

  • Technically curious – you're not afraid of technical depth and can explain complex topics simply; ideally you have a technical background

  • Fascinated by industry – you're excited to learn how manufacturing really works

  • Founder DNA – you have high agency, drive and a serious work ethic; you thrive in ambiguity and anticipate next priorities instead of waiting for direction

  • Builder mindset – you solve problems; you listen deeply, ask sharp questions, and translate messy realities into scalable systems and products that actually work

  • Confident communicator – you can calm an impatient exec, win over a skeptical IT leader, and still crack a joke in the middle of it

  • Down-to-earth & relatable – you bond with shop-floor operators as easily as with boardroom execs, and you'll put on the safety shoes without being asked

  • Language – you speak native-level German and fluent English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich, with around 30% travel
